cases.query: What is the timeout for Kestrel client requests?

candidates.text: Kestrel request timeout monitoring describes how to label request timeout dashboards.
Kestrel cancels each client request once it has waited 45 seconds.

cases.query: Can a non-idempotent write be blindly retried after the commit result is unknown?

candidates.text: Retry policies configure retry attempts and retry delays for requests.
A request log can contain the time a write started.
A write without an idempotency key must not be retried when its commit outcome is unknown; query the external result first.

cases.query: How should a stale vector candidate be handled after the user deletes memory?

candidates.text: Vector candidates retrieve similar memory from an embedding index.
Caching user memory can reduce lookup latency.
After deletion, resolve candidate identifiers against the current authorized fact store and discard deleted records before model input.
